The present petition under Article 226 of the Constitution of India read with Section 482 of the Cr.P.C. seeks the following prayers:-
"(a) Declare the act of freezing the account of the Petitioner by the Respondent as illegal, arbitrary and unconstitutional, and further issue directions to the Respondent to de-freeze the bank account of the Petitioner subject to taking bank guarantee;
and/or ( b) issue suitable directions, orders as are deemed necessary in the facts and circumstances of the case.
AND FOR THIS ACT OF KINDNESS, THE PETITIONER / APPLICANT / NOTICEE / ACCUSED SHALL AS DUTY BOUND EVER PRAY:"
2. Learned Additional Standing Counsel for the State has placed on record the status report and on instructions of the Investigating Officer, submits that approximately Rs. 95 lakhs is being presently investigated qua the present petitioner's account.
It is submitted that subject to freezing an amount of Rs. 95 lakhs in the account of the petitioner, the latter will be permitted to operate his account at this stage.

In accordance with aforenoted directions, while the Petitioner has been permitted to operate the bank account in question, nonetheless, an amount of INR 95 Lakhs is being detained/withheld.

The Petitioner asserts that they have fully cooperated with the investigation, appearing before the Respondent as and when required, and have repeatedly requested the release of the withheld amount, but to no avail.

Aggrieved by the prolonged freezing of funds and the protracted nature of the investigation, the Petitioner has approached this Court seeking appropriate directions for the release of the detained amount.

sentences.text: The seizure of any property under Section 102 of CrPC is a measure to facilitate an ongoing investigation.
In financial fraud cases, freezing a bank account suspected of holding illicit funds is often necessary to prevent their dissipation and ensure that the investigation is not frustrated.
The transactional trail, as outlined by the Respondent, indicates flow of funds from the alleged fraudulent source to the Petitioner's account on the same day.
Considering the nature of the allegations and the ongoing investigation, it would be premature for this Court to intervene and order the release of the detained amount at this stage.
Accordingly, the request for release of the detained amount is declined.
10. While the request for release of the detained amount is declined, the Court deems it appropriate to issue directions for growth of the funds while the investigation remains pending.
Accordingly, the Manager, HDFC Bank, Chandigarh, is directed to place the detained amount of INR 95 Lakhs in a Fixed Deposit, ensuring that it accrues interest at the applicable rate.
The Fixed Deposit shall be automatically renewed unless directed otherwise by

11. The Respondent is expected to expedite the investigation in FIR No. 86/2024 and make all efforts to conclude it within six months from today.

12. If no incriminating material is found against the Petitioner upon conclusion of the investigation,
the Petitioner shall be at liberty to seek release of the detained amount by moving an appropriate application before the concerned court.
13. It is made clear that nothing in the said order shall be construed as the Court's opinion on the merits of the case.
All rights and contentions of the parties are left open.
14. With the above directions, the present petition is disposed of.
